description: Creates a crash-consistent, point-in-time copy of an existing Amazon EBS volume within the same Availability Zone. The volume copy can be attached to an Amazon EC2 instance once it reaches the available state.
mitreAttackTechniques: T1537 - Transfer Data to Cloud Account

researchLinks.description: Share an EBS Volume for Cross-Account Cloning

securityImplications: Attackers might use CopyVolumes on an EBS volume shared with their account to clone the victim's data; the call is also logged in the owner's account, with the attacker's account as the caller.
